title: Nyx/Prime
extract:
Release Date: September 23rd, 2014
 Nyx Prime is the Primed variant of  Nyx, possessing higher shield, armor, sprint speed, as well as an additional  polarity. Nyx Prime was released alongside  Hikou Prime and  Scindo Prime.

Acquisition
Unlike most Prime gear, Nyx Prime is permanently unvaulted, with relics being obtainable through Abandoned Derelict Caches in Corpus Railjack missions.

Vaulted
On August 9th, 2016, it was announced that Nyx Prime, alongside  Hikou Prime and  Scindo Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on August 23rd, 2016. Any preexisting components, relics or fully-built frames will remain as is.
Nyx Prime,  Hikou Prime, and  Scindo Prime can occasionally be acquired via Prime Resurgence, in addition to having their relics obtainable as part of the aforementioned Railjack missions.

Crafting

Notes
 Nyx Prime, compared to  Nyx:
Higher Shields (365/465 vs. 270/370)
Higher Armor (135 vs. 105)
Higher Starting Energy (150 vs. 100)
Higher Sprint Speed (1.125 vs. 1.1)
Additional  Polarity ( vs. )
As with any other Prime Warframe, moving close to the location of an Orokin Void Death Orb will restore a pulse of 250 Energy to nearby allies, even if that Death Orb is inactive, destroyed, or non-present. This effect can only occur once per orb.

Trivia
Nyx Prime was the first Prime Warframe to have two enhanced stats, at the time she received increased  Armor and Sprint speed over her normal version. When Update 17.0 (2015-07-31) launched she received an additional boost in Shield.
Enemies affected by Nyx Prime's  Chaos now show a Nyx Prime holding a  Braton Prime instead of a regular  Nyx holding a standard  Braton.
